scope: Frozen seed42 epoch29 BA1000/BA1500 GCN/GraphSAGE; existing evidence only
freeze: Thresholds fixed before policy evaluation, not before the historical audit. No claim of prospective preregistration.

P1.rule: Exact identities, epoch29 and all protected hashes unchanged

P2.rule: Verified directed candidate ordering, src/dst/target concatenation, state orientation, same-input MLP and artifact semantics

P3.rule: Report PASS or WARN; never reject on raw allclose alone
P3.rationale: Latent float32 magnitudes and device arithmetic are not the explanation; downstream behavior is decisive.

P4.rationale: Deterministic top20 defines the actual explanation. No averaging away failures or fallback to 0.99.

P5.rule: No collapse or topK change. Nonexact argsort allowed only for same-GT-class tied/near-tied relation changes, with no strict inversion. Near tie means raw gap <= 2*(atol+rtol*max(abs(raw pair))) using frozen P3 values.

P6.rationale: User-proposed practical bounds on unit-scale metrics: 0.5 and 2 percentage points. AP is more sensitive to exact threshold groups. These are explicit policy judgments, not universal statistical significance bounds or thresholds fitted to observed maxima.

P7.rationale: Class-flip outcomes must not change. 1e-4 is an explicit small probability/ratio-unit drift budget, applied per metric per target, without cancellation.

P8.rule: Report saturation separately; warn but do not automatically reject. Score mean/std are equally weighted per-target population statistics, matching primary aggregate semantics.

coverage.validation: All 88 historical mismatch keys are supporting sensitivity evidence, not a substitute for final-test coverage.

stress.rule: Apply P4/P5/P6 to every existing node1465 repeat. WARN TIE_SENSITIVE_AP for nonzero within-budget AP drift supported by same-class tie splitting. Missing repeat evidence is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not PASS.

decision.readiness: All four cells accepted, complete nonfailing stress evidence, no unresolved semantics or hard-gate failure.

limitations: Finite recorded replays do not prove universal CUDA determinism.
Numerical acceptance does not prove explanation quality or resolve saturation.
This policy does not revalidate every historical training/validation row.
No new inference, score modification, epsilon grouping, training, backward or optimizer steps.
historical_interpretation: Archive original INVALID unchanged; a new accepted scientific decision supersedes byte equality only as acceptance interpretation. It does not make the old verifier PASS.
